in_hebrew.name: פטאי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A diminutive form of the name Pethuel, which means 'small, little, or diminutive'. In Hebrew, the name Petey is written as פטאי (Pethai), and its pronunciation is /pɛˈtai̯/.

in_greek.name: Πέταιος
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the Hebrew name Petai, meaning 'little, small, or humble'. In Greek, the name Petey is written as Πέταιος (Petaios), and its pronunciation is /pɛˈtaios/.

in_latin.name: Petaius
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the Greek name Petaios, meaning 'little, small, or humble'. In Latin, the name Petey is written as Petaius, and its pronunciation is /pɛˈtajʊs/.
